scope: Nine previously authorized repairs, all implemented before current fresh reviews. This author inventory is used to bind current verification without inventing a canonical reviewer task for historical model-label-only reports. Archived original reports and actual original-owner callbacks are preserved separately.

observations.original_quote: 這兩份工作不必用同一套數字：**query 表示提出需求，key 表示提供匹配線索**，所以模型為它們準備不同的可調配方。
observations.author_action_taken: 現文已教兩種角色、投影與形狀；加一個具體任務中的雙向需求，說清同一位置要找的線索與供別人匹配的特徵可各自調整。
observations.added_burden: 短情境及2–4句，沿用點積；不增加推導或保證效果。
observations.provenance: Root-owned repair inventory transcribed from archived actual prior recommendations, not a new independent rediscovery or a relabeling of the original reviewer. Raw report/task label retained byte-exact.
